addPresetChecks.description: Whether to create an empty project (`true`) or a preset project (`false`).

checkInterval.description:
- `not set` — default value per subscription plan
- `5 minutes` — every 5 minutes
- `30 minutes` — every 30 minutes
- `1 hour` — every hour
- `8 hours` — every 8 hours
- `1 day` — every day
- `7 days` — every week
- `false` — run manually, no schedule
